notes.3: BORDERLINE. 'agricultural tool for grinding grains' then 'also a type of grinding stone used for making tools and weapons'. notes.15: 'its name must be her name', then the girl's mother, then 'her age: 32' with no clear antecedent.
notes.20: One thing said (a name) then unrelated exam drift. Called fits, not too-little, because one consistent thing WAS said.
